AGENDA

Roll Call

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items

so at this time.

Approval of the minutes of the meetings held on April 14, 2022.

Permit Request (s):

Item #1:  Alesha Briggs DBA Giving Youth Opportunities to host a Spring Art & Gardening
  Event at 400 W. Beach Ave, Rogers Park, on Saturday, May 07, 2022, from 12:00
  p.m. – 4:00 p.m. (Activity No.00341278)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #2:  Angela Williams DBA City of Inglewood to host a Free Community Document
  Shredding Event between Grevillea and Manchester Blvd., Public Property, from
  Saturday, May 21, 2022, Saturday, August 27, 2022, and Saturday, November 5,
  2022, from 9:00 a.m. – 1:00 p.m. (Activity No.00341259)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #3:  David Rice DBA Taste of Inglewood to host a Taste of Inglewood Jazz Fest Event
  at 700 Warren Ln., Edward Vincent Park, from Saturday, Agust 06, 2022, and
  Sunday, Agust 07, 2022, from 11:00 a.m. – 7:00 p.m. (Activity No.00341261)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.
